6.200 rsInvalidScopeInInnerAggregateOfPreviousAggregate
rsInvalidScopeInInnerAggregateOfPreviousAggregate is a critical error that occurs when a Previous
aggregate function uses within its Expression parameter an aggregate function whose scope is not
equal to or is not contained by the scope that is specified by the PreviousScope parameter.
